# DESIGN.md — Zaban

A design system for an app that teaches heritage languages: Urdu, Punjabi,
Bengali, Nigerian Pidgin, Arabic, and nine more. Most of its learners are
reaching for a language their family speaks and they do not, which is a tender
thing to be bad at. Every decision below is downstream of that.

## Overview

**Warm, literary, unhurried.** Not a productivity tool and not a game. The
nearest reference is a well-made paperback rather than a dashboard — cream
paper, a serif for the things that matter, generous line height, and no
scoreboard shouting at you.

**What this is not.** No streak-shaming, no red crosses, no leaderboard, no
confetti for its own sake. The app deliberately removed the ✗ mark on wrong
answers: a cross is a mark on schoolwork and says "you failed" and stops there.
Amber says "look here", which is the actual instruction.

**Right-to-left is a first-class case, not a fix.** Urdu, Arabic, Punjabi
(Shahmukhi) and Persian all set `dir="rtl"`. Layouts are built so mirroring is
correct by construction.

---

## Colors

Three complete themes. Every token is defined in all three — a token that only
one theme overrides is the bug that once shipped a dark theme measured at 1.2:1
contrast, which is invisible rather than merely low. `scripts/validate-themes.mjs`
fails the build if a token is missing anywhere.

Contrast is verified against WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text) by
`scripts/audit-a11y.mjs`, which composites semi-transparent surfaces and walks
gradient grounds rather than skipping them.

### The one rule that keeps being learned the hard way

**A colour has one job.** `--primary` is a *fill*; `--primary-text` is the same
hue darkened enough to be read *as text* on the page ground. `--accent` and
`--accent-text` are the same pairing. Using a fill colour as a text colour is
how this app shipped 2.1:1 body copy twice.

The solid-button trio is the sharpest case: `--ink-solid` is the button, and
`--ink-on` is the text on it. They invert together in dark mode — a dark theme
needs a **light** button with **dark** text, which is the exact opposite of what
`--ink` must be for body copy.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Body & UI | `"Nunito", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif` | Rounded, friendly, wide language coverage |
| Display | `"Fraunces", Georgia, serif` | Headings and the wordmark — warm and literary |
| Target language | System script fonts | Never overridden; a learner must see the script as it really looks |

- Base size **16px**. Never smaller than 12px for body text.
- Line height **1.5** for UI, looser for connected reading text.
- `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` anywhere numbers are compared or counted.
- Both faces are self-hosted and preloaded. Nothing is fetched from a third
  party: a Google Fonts request sends the reader's IP to Google, which a German
  court found unlawful without consent (LG München I, 3 O 17493/20).

## Layout

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--radius` | `16px` |
| `--radius-lg` | `22px` |
| Shadow, card | `0 1px 2px rgba(46, 36, 20, 0.05), 0 4px 16px rgba(46, 36, 20, 0.05)` |
| Shadow, button | `0 4px 0 var(--primary-dark)` |

- **Mobile-first.** Designed at 414×896 and up. The bottom nav is the primary
  navigation; a side rail appears at desktop widths.
- **Minimum touch target 44×44px**, with at least 8px between adjacent targets.
- Full-bleed surfaces respect `env(safe-area-inset-*)` — this ships as an
  installable PWA and runs under notches.
- Wide content scrolls inside its own container. The page body never scrolls
  horizontally.

---

## Motion

| Token | Curve | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--ease-spring` | `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` | Playful overshoot — rewards, reveals |
| `--ease-out-expo` | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | Fast start, soft landing — entrances |
| `--ease-smooth` | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` | Everything else |

- Durations **150–300ms**. Motion carries meaning or it does not happen.
- Animate `transform` and `opacity`. Never `transition: all` — it animates
  layout properties on the main thread, and `scripts/audit-interface.mjs` fails
  the build on it.
- `prefers-reduced-motion` is honoured throughout.

---

## Components

**Buttons.** Solid `--ink-solid` with `--ink-on` text for the primary action;
`--primary` with `--on-primary` for affirmative ones. A visible `:focus-visible`
ring on every interactive element — `outline: none` without a replacement fails
the interface audit.

**Cards.** `--surface` on `--bg`, 1px `--border`, `--radius-lg`. Elevation is
carried by the border and a very soft shadow, not by heavy drop shadows.

**Answer feedback.** Correct is green-tinted with `--primary-text`; a miss is
**amber**, never red, and uses `--miss`. The card is a `role="status"` live
region so a screen reader announces the result.

**Corrections.** Ask before telling: the learner sees a question that points at
the problem without containing the answer, and the corrected form appears after
their attempt or when they tap **Show me**. This is a pedagogy decision with a
visual consequence — the answer is genuinely not on screen yet.

---

## Content & copy

- **Second person, plain words.** "It doesn't have to be exact" appears in those
  words in several places; anything new must sound like the same person wrote it.
- **Never claim something the app doesn't do.** "Unlimited hearts" and "Offline
  mode" both shipped as false claims and both had to be removed or made true.
- Sentence case for headings. Numerals for counts.
- `…` not `...`. Curly quotes. Loading states end in `…`.
- Errors say what to do next, not just what went wrong.

---

## Do

- Define every token in every theme.
- Pair a fill colour with its own text colour.
- Lead with what still works when something breaks.
- Let the target language's own script set the tone of a screen.

## Don't

- Use `--primary` or `--accent` as a text colour on the page ground.
- Mark a wrong answer with a cross, or red.
- Animate `all`, or remove a focus ring without replacing it.
- Add a screen without adding it to `scripts/audit-a11y.mjs`.
- Ship a claim about the product that isn't checked by a script.
